auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.sideText: Book appointments and describe your symptoms in your preferred language. Our system automatically detects your language and adapts the interface.

home.title: Your Healthcare, in Your Language
home.subtitle: CareBridge connects you to medical professionals while allowing you to schedule appointments and explain symptoms in English, Yoruba, Hausa, or Igbo. The system automatically adapts to you.
home.describeSymptomsDesc: Type symptoms in your preferred language. CareBridge dynamically adapts the interface layout, logs, and fields to support your experience.
home.designedDesc: CareBridge Hospital combines exceptional clinical standards with language artificial intelligence to ensure you and your family are fully understood.
home.featureSpecialtiesDesc: From General Medicine and Pediatrics to Antenatal Care, Ophthalmology, and Cardiology, our expert clinicians provide comprehensive care.
home.featureLanguageDesc: Describe your condition comfortably in English, Yoruba, Hausa, or Igbo. Our machine learning pipelines identify the language to support localization.
home.featureSecurityDesc: Your medical notes, symptom profiles, and appointment records are strictly safeguarded with high security and privacy protocols.
home.copyright: © 2026 CareBridge Hospital Portal. All rights reserved.

dashboard.summary: Manage your health appointments quickly and easily. Switch languages at any time or let our system detect it automatically based on your symptom notes.

booking.title: Book an Appointment
booking.subtitle: Choose a department and doctor, pick a date, and describe your symptoms. The system will detect your language as you type.
booking.loadError: Failed to load departments and doctors. Please try again.
booking.error: Failed to book appointment. Please check your inputs and try again.
booking.symptomsPlaceholder: Describe how you feel (e.g., I have a headache and fever... or Mo ni iba ati efori...)
booking.pickDateForSlots: Pick a doctor and date to see available slots.
booking.noSlots: No free slots for this date. Choose another date.
booking.confirmMessage: Book this appointment for the selected doctor, date, and time?

appointments.title: My Appointments
appointments.subtitle: View your upcoming and past medical appointments.
appointments.rescheduleSuccess: Your appointment time has been updated.
appointments.confirmCancelMessage: This appointment will be marked as cancelled. You can book another time afterwards.

admin.confirmDeleteDoctorMessage: Pending and confirmed appointments for this doctor will be cancelled before the profile is removed.

confirmed.title: Confirm appointment?
confirmed.message: This marks the patient appointment as confirmed.

completed.title: Complete appointment?
completed.message: This marks the consultation as completed.

cancelled.title: Cancel appointment?
cancelled.message: This cancels the patient appointment and removes it from active bookings.

toast.syncError: Could not sync with the server. Check permissions.
toast.doctorDeleted: Doctor profile removed and appointments cancelled.
toast.doctorCreateError: Failed. Ensure user exists with role doctor.

patient.systemDesc: Your health is our priority. Manage consultations, track appointments, and describe symptoms in your preferred language all in one secure system.
patient.wellnessDesc: Drink at least 8 glasses of water today. Proper hydration supports kidney function, lubricates joints, and sustains your energy levels throughout the day.
patient.langDetectionDesc: Describe symptoms comfortably in English, Yoruba, Hausa, or Igbo. Our machine-learning algorithms automatically identify your language to tailor your clinical registry.
